entry.author: Te Hiringa Mahara
entry.summary:
The ‘Power of co-design for rangatahi and youth mental health’ webinar presented the key findings from our early intervention and secondary prevention effectiveness review and brought rangatahi and young people together to talk about the importance of co-design, what does and does not work well, and examples of co-design in practice, with learnings for improvement.

Our panellists were: 
- Laura Ross, Te Hiringa Mahara
- Alex Walker, Lived Experience Researcher
- Maggie Shippam
- Abdulla Shiblaq, Yes Disability
- Ariel Waldron, Yes Disability
- Amy Skipper, Mental Health Matters Initiative

The webinar was held on Monday 18 May 2026. This was the first day of Youth Week 2026.  We will add Captions by the end of May. 

Read our new reports on Effectiveness of early intervention and secondary prevention supports for young people, released 30 April 2026: https://www.mhwc.govt.nz/our-work/wellbeing/effectiveness-of-early-intervention-and-secondary-prevention-supports-for-young-people/
